text:
Maria P.: Hey team — opened a small docs PR that cleans the embeddings quickstart and adds a minimal Python + curl example. Would appreciate a quick pass before I merge today if possible: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

Ajay S.: Taking a look now.

Noah K.: On it; will run the snippets locally and check output shapes.

DevEx Bot: CI green ✅ — build #482 passed (lint / docs-build)

Kim L.: quick q — did you switch the curl snippet to use the Bearer header? want to keep parity with SDK examples.

Maria P.: Yep — changed to Bearer. Snippet is:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input": "Why pinecones are weird"}'
```

Ajay S.: LGTM besides a tiny YAML frontmatter typo (title: -> title: "Embeddings quickstart")

Noah K.: Also: add a short 'expected output' block showing the vector length (e.g., 1536 dims) so people don't wonder why numbers vary.

Maria P.: Good catches — added the frontmatter fix and an output sample (and a short note about model variants and dims). Updated PR with a screenshot of the sample run.

Ajay S.: Approve :+1:

Noah K.: Approve

Kim L.: small nit but fine from doc side :thumbsup: 

Maria P.: Thanks y'all — I'll merge in ~30m if no objections.

DevEx Bot: Merged by Maria P. — commit 7f8a3c2 (docs: embeddings quickstart updates) — 30m later
